ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 80-85% of the visible fluke surface, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the periphery and at the central peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions occupy the interior of both the left and right lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous, irregular border along the trailing edge and lower leading margins. A high-contrast black triangular region is centered at the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring jagged peaks and valleys with varying pixel amplitudes, particularly pronounced at the lateral terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the lower leading edges, transitioning into slightly concave segments as the lobes approach the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple high-contrast linear marks, including a prominent curvilinear 'hook' shaped dark mark on the upper right lobe and several vertical dark streaks on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive large crescent-shaped dark scar located on the upper quadrant of the right lobe; highly irregular, jagged trailing edge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique hook-shaped pigmentation mark on the right lobe provides a highly specific spatial identifier.
